name: ollama
description: Local inference runtime. Models run on-device, zero cost, zero latency to external APIs.

name: anthropic
description: Claude models via Anthropic API. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

name: openai
description: GPT models via OpenAI API. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY.

name: llama-cpp-chat
description: In-process llama.cpp chat. Runs a local GGUF on-device with no external daemon — the default first hop for text chains. Active only when the daemon is built with embedded-llama-cpp and a chat GGUF is present.

name: llama-cpp-embed
description: In-process llama.cpp embeddings. 384-dim GGUF on-device, no external daemon — the default first hop for the embed chain. Active only when the daemon is built with embedded-llama-cpp and an embed GGUF is present.

name: nvidia
description: NVIDIA NIM — OpenAI-compatible hosted inference. Requires NVIDIA_API_KEY.
